summary: Fixed P0 bug: Like/heart icon was not clickable due to z-index issue. The Video Error Overlay (z-40) was blocking clicks to the action buttons (z-20). Fixed by increasing action buttons z-index to z-50. Video playback shows 'Video Unavailable' error in headless browser which is expected UX (CORS/network issues with local video file). Backend APIs working correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: The z-index issue could have been caught during initial implementation by testing with video error state visible
Consider establishing a z-index scale/hierarchy document for the project to prevent similar issues
The Video Error Overlay should ideally have a 'pointer-events: none' property except for the Try Again button to not block other UI elements

rca_of_the_issue.bug_description: Like/heart icon was not responding to clicks on the VideoPlayerPage when video error was displayed
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Z-index layering issue - The Video Error Overlay div had z-index: 40 while the action buttons container only had z-index: 20. When the video failed to load and the error overlay appeared, it blocked all clicks to the action buttons behind it.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Changed action buttons container z-index from z-20 to z-50 (line 1828)
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Tested by clicking like button with video error visible - API call now succeeds and UI updates correctly
